control.boundary: Full UX authoring, structural repair, independent review and review-directed rework through an exact passing receipt; no UI generation.

unitReuseMethod: Nonoverlapping equal JSON subtrees at identical paths; excludes unchanged property-name and punctuation overhead, and does not match moved array entries. Python JSON normalization caveat also applies. Skipped if baseline candidates are ambiguous.
limits: Actor windows overlap and must not be summed.
Marker intervals include tool-call preparation and may cross actors; they are not pure reasoning time.
Per-command streams and previous-result gaps can overlap for concurrent calls; do not sum them as elapsed time. Gaps can include idle time between turns.
Pointer JSON-number normalization may require exact JavaScript rechecking if a verification mismatch is reported.
Independent review and full authoring exceed the scope of the earlier compact comparison experiment.
Model-request observer disabled: wire flags, auxiliary approval requests and wire-based response grouping are unobserved, not zero.
Compaction gaps run from the preceding tool result to the compaction record; their internal computation/scheduling split is unobserved.
maxOutstandingNativeReads counts calls before their results in runtime order. It does not establish backend flags or exact model-response grouping.
This replay and the prior full replay share a baseline but differ in generated decisions, findings, coordination and interruption; observed timing differences are not a controlled causal speedup.
Runtime usage totals sum recorded responses including compactions. Parent final-turn usage differs; cached counters are not unique bytes or a bill.
The active client window excludes prelaunch editing/permission discussion and post-run supervisor analysis/checkpoint time.

decisions: Named clips create independent video-owned copies. Library updates affect future additions and do not propagate into prior copies.
